comments.author: AliBayan
comments.body:
Just got the license - funny, but it popped out for me at once, with no need for QMPs.
I personally think it's a great job. I mostly procure / collect / fish stuff I'm doing stuff out of, wherever possible. It means mostly no need for POs, port hops, whatevurs, and it even can get you quite decent adv points.
With this profession, doing so at cast away locations won't be an overkill neither for gathering skills, nor for the cooking / storage.

comments.author: George
comments.body: It's a good job, but I daresay not absolutely essential and, perhaps, not worth many 10s of QMPs. I reached r15 cooking and chef meister title all the way with animal trader. Appreciated the livestock trading skill. Didn't mind switching to fisher, storing loads of fish in my quarters, then switching back to animal trader to make vigour food out of them. There's one and only one r16 cooking recipe in game and I would already be able to execute it if I had the book thanks to ribbon or aide. I might or might not try getting this, or maybe better the patissier job at some point to work up to base r16 - just for completeness.

comments.author: DreadPirateWesley
comments.body:
Actually George this is a fairly good job. Considering it has Fishing, Collect, Procure and Storage as fave skills you dont really have to change to other jobs to gather goods needed to make dishes.
I've found chef job great when Im in need of college credits because I change to chef and do the chicken/duck-egg-chicken thesis :)

comments.author: George
comments.body:
Well you don't really need chef job just to do the chicken-egg thesis. Both recipes are very low rank and don't help grind either cooking or storage after a while. So the tradeoff is 10s of QMPs that you could sell for 10s of millions or the hassle to change jobs every day. I took a day fishing in Syracuse with fisher job and FA college skills loaded until 999 tuna stored in my quarters, then changed to animal trader, made tuna steaks or used storage to produce fish and make fish and nuts (loads of berries also collected earlier or imported from farm). I guess it helped that my toon is french, so it's a short sail Syracuse - Marseilles to drop the fish and go back to fish more. I guess it would have been different if he was like dutch.

Anyway, I don't really disagree with you. It's a trade-off, people can choose which way to go.
